fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on the approaching 1927–1928 winter tourist season and concerns about price gouging (including electricity rates), discussion of the defeat of an auditorium bond issue, and criticism of city services and transportation. Coverage includes local politics and elections, law enforcement and court proceedings (including a criminal case involving automobile larceny), and items about public utilities and Florida Power & Light Company. Also includes society/column material, advertisements, and notices about seasonal openings and entertainment in Greater Miami.
